name: What is the typical timeframe to see results from a multi-location GEO strategy?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe to see results from a multi-location GEO strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe to see results from a multi-location GEO strategy can vary, but businesses typically start observing initial improvements within 3 to 6 months. This period allows for sufficient time to optimize Google Business Profiles, correct NAP inconsistencies, build local citations, and for search engines to recrawl and re-index these changes. Significant and sustained improvements, especially in competitive markets, usually develop over 6 to 12 months as local authority builds, review counts grow, and ongoing optimization fine-tunes performance for each specific location.
acceptedAnswer.description: Initial GEO results typically appear within 3-6 months, with more significant improvements developing over 6-12 months as local authority and optimization efforts mature.
